question: 'My Dateless Diary’ is a novel written by whom among the following authors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**RK Narayan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **RK Narayan**, full name Rasipuram Krishnaswami Iyer Narayanaswami, was an Indian writer known for his works set in the fictional South Indian town of Malgudi.
 
• He is one of the most celebrated Indian authors writing in English, with a literary career spanning over six decades.
 
• **My Dateless Diary** is a collection of journal entries and essays by RK Narayan, reflecting his thoughts and experiences during his stay in the United States in the 1950s.
 
• Some of his other notable works include **Swami and Friends**, **The Guide**, and **Malgudi Days**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swami and Friends**

 
 
• It is the first novel written by RK Narayan, published in 1935.
 
• The novel is set in the fictional town of Malgudi and revolves around a young boy named Swaminathan.
 
• It is known for its simple narrative style and vivid depiction of Indian life.
 
 
 
• **The Guide**
 
 
• Published in 1958, The Guide is one of RK Narayan's most famous works.
 
• The novel tells the story of Raju, a tour guide turned spiritual guide, and explores themes of transformation and redemption.
 
• It won the Sahitya Akademi Award in 1960 and was later adapted into a successful film.
 
 
 
• **Malgudi Days**
 
 
• Malgudi Days is a collection of short stories by RK Narayan, first published in 1943.
 
• The stories are set in the fictional town of Malgudi and feature a wide range of characters and situations.
 
• The book has been adapted into a popular television series in India.
 
 
 
• **RK Narayan's Writing Style**
 
 
• Narayan is known for his simple, unpretentious prose and his ability to capture the essence of everyday life in India.
 
• His works often feature gentle humor and a deep understanding of human nature.
 
• He has been compared to other great writers like Mark Twain and Anton Chekhov for his storytelling abilities.
